nodes.name: github.go
nodes.summary: Provides the host-side GitHub CLI adapter, workflow data types, issue and pull-request operations, and exact commit-status publishing.
nodes.languageNotes: Keeps credentials inside the locally authenticated gh process and exchanges typed JSON payloads.

nodes.name: Repository
nodes.summary: Identifies a GitHub repository by owner and name.

nodes.name: Issue
nodes.summary: Contains the issue snapshot fields needed by factory claim and state workflows.

nodes.name: Label
nodes.summary: Describes a factory-owned GitHub label and its presentation metadata.

nodes.name: Comment
nodes.summary: Carries the identity and body of a GitHub issue comment.

nodes.name: PullRequest
nodes.summary: Represents pull-request identity, content, lifecycle state, draft status, and branch pair.

nodes.name: PullRequestRequest
nodes.summary: Defines stable title, body, branch, and draft fields for pull-request mutations.

nodes.name: CommitStatus
nodes.summary: Identifies a status state and description attached to one exact commit SHA.

nodes.name: CommitStatusPublisher
nodes.summary: Defines the host-side seam for publishing exact-SHA GitHub commit statuses.

nodes.name: Client
nodes.summary: Defines the issue, label, and comment operations exposed to the claim coordinator.

nodes.name: PullRequestClient
nodes.summary: Defines isolated discovery and mutation operations for idempotent draft pull requests.

nodes.name: CommandRunner
nodes.summary: Defines the executable seam used to invoke the local GitHub CLI.

nodes.name: GhClient
nodes.summary: Implements host-side GitHub operations through an injected or production gh command runner.

nodes.name: String
nodes.summary: Formats a repository as the owner/name string accepted by gh.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.summary: Executes the gh binary with optional JSON input and turns stderr into a contextual error.

nodes.name: NewClient
nodes.summary: Constructs a GitHub CLI client with the production command runner.

nodes.name: Issue
nodes.summary: Fetches and normalizes one issue snapshot, including labels, pull-request identity, and update time.

nodes.name: CreateLabel
nodes.summary: Creates one factory-owned label through the GitHub API.

nodes.name: ReplaceIssueLabels
nodes.summary: Replaces an issue's factory state labels while retaining the adapter's typed repository boundary.

nodes.name: CreateIssueComment
nodes.summary: Posts one comment to a GitHub issue and returns its normalized identity.

nodes.name: FindStatusComment
nodes.summary: Finds a factory status comment by marker while paginating issue comments through gh.

nodes.name: EditIssueComment
nodes.summary: Updates the body of an existing GitHub issue comment.

nodes.name: FindPullRequest
nodes.summary: Locates a pull request by head and base branches and normalizes the matching response.

nodes.name: CreatePullRequest
nodes.summary: Creates a pull request from the validated title, body, branch, and draft request.

nodes.name: UpdatePullRequest
nodes.summary: Updates an existing pull request while preserving the typed mutation boundary.

nodes.name: CreateCommitStatus
nodes.summary: Publishes a validated pending, success, failure, or error status to one exact commit SHA.

nodes.name: callJSON
nodes.summary: Runs a GitHub CLI API request and decodes its JSON response into a destination value.

nodes.name: callBytes
nodes.summary: Runs a GitHub CLI API request and returns raw response bytes with contextual errors.

nodes.name: ValidCommitSHA
nodes.summary: Checks that a commit identifier is exactly 40 or 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

nodes.name: decodePullRequestList
nodes.summary: Decodes GitHub pull-request JSON and converts each response into the project pull-request type.

nodes.name: validatePullRequestRequest
nodes.summary: Validates pull-request title, body, and branch fields before API mutation.

nodes.name: runtime.go
nodes.summary: Defines the isolated worker runtime seams and implements hardened Docker lifecycle, command, mount, environment, and session operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses narrow Go interfaces to keep Docker identifiers, credentials, and host paths private to the adapter.

nodes.name: CacheMount
nodes.summary: Describes one explicitly declared repository cache mount and its access mode.

nodes.name: StartRequest
nodes.summary: Carries immutable image identity, paths, caches, invocation directories, credentials, and role inputs for worker creation.

nodes.name: ResumeRequest
nodes.summary: Carries run and image identity needed to resume an existing worker without changing its image.

nodes.name: CommandRequest
nodes.summary: Defines a deterministic command, worker identity, environment policy, role, and explicit variables.

nodes.name: CommandResult
nodes.summary: Reports process exit code and captured standard output and error from a worker command.

nodes.name: InteractiveRequest
nodes.summary: Describes a host-mediated interactive command and its explicit worker environment.

nodes.name: InteractiveCommand
nodes.summary: Carries the host helper executable and arguments used to attach a terminal to a worker.

nodes.name: CredentialSeedRequest
nodes.summary: Selects a run and explicit host auth file for narrow credential seeding.

nodes.name: NativeSessionRequest
nodes.summary: Selects a worker run and harness format for native session lookup.

nodes.name: InteractiveRuntime
nodes.summary: Optional runtime interface for producing a visible terminal attach command.

nodes.name: CredentialSeeder
nodes.summary: Optional runtime interface for streaming one explicit Codex auth file into a worker.

nodes.name: NativeSessionProvider
nodes.summary: Optional runtime interface for retrieving the newest native session identifier.

nodes.name: NativeSessionSnapshotProvider
nodes.summary: Optional runtime interface for listing persisted native sessions before a fresh launch.

nodes.name: Inspection
nodes.summary: Reports worker existence, running state, image, and configured mount information without exposing runtime identifiers.

nodes.name: ContainerMount
nodes.summary: Describes a host source, in-container destination, and read-only bind-mount flag.

nodes.name: WorkerRuntime
nodes.summary: Defines the portable worker lifecycle, command, stop, and inspection seam used by workflow code.

nodes.name: DockerRuntime
nodes.summary: Implements the worker runtime through Docker while keeping container names and paths private.

nodes.name: NewDockerRuntime
nodes.summary: Constructs a Docker-backed worker runtime with default executable settings.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Validates and creates or reuses a hardened Docker worker with the exact image digest and mount contract.

nodes.name: Resume
nodes.summary: Validates immutable identity and resumes a stopped worker after inspecting its expected container state.

nodes.name: RunCommand
nodes.summary: Validates a command request, constructs a private Docker exec environment, and returns typed process output.

nodes.name: InteractiveCommand
nodes.summary: Builds a host attach-helper command for an interactive worker request without exposing the Docker name to callers.

nodes.name: SeedCodexCredentials
nodes.summary: Validates and streams one host Codex auth file into the worker's role home without mounting the host directory.

nodes.name: NativeSessionIDs
nodes.summary: Reads and validates persisted native session identifiers from the worker role home in stable order.

nodes.name: NativeSessionID
nodes.summary: Returns the newest native session identifier or an explicit not-found error.

nodes.name: Attach
nodes.summary: Validates an interactive request, inspects the worker, and runs the host terminal attach helper.

nodes.name: Stop
nodes.summary: Stops the worker identified by a run ID while retaining its container for later resume.

nodes.name: Inspect
nodes.summary: Inspects the run's private container and reports absence separately from Docker runtime failures.

nodes.name: recreateWorker
nodes.summary: Recreates a worker container through Docker after a stale or incompatible instance is removed.

nodes.name: inspectContainer
nodes.summary: Parses Docker inspection output into lifecycle, image, and mount identity data for contract checks.

nodes.name: parseDockerInspectionJSON
nodes.summary: Decodes Docker inspection JSON and normalizes mount metadata into the runtime inspection model.

nodes.name: runDockerWithInput
nodes.summary: Runs a Docker command with optional stdin, captures output, and preserves exit-code details in runtime errors.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Formats a Docker runtime error with its operation and contextual message.

nodes.name: Unwrap
nodes.summary: Exposes the underlying Docker runtime cause for standard Go error traversal.

nodes.name: validateStartRequest
nodes.summary: Validates worker identity, image digest, directories, environment, caches, and mount contracts before startup.

nodes.name: workerMountsPresent
nodes.summary: Checks whether inspected mounts satisfy the required invocation and result mount identities.

nodes.name: requiredInvocationMounts
nodes.summary: Builds the stable set of invocation and result destinations required for one worker launch.

nodes.name: expectedWorkerMounts
nodes.summary: Derives expected worktree, Git, cache, credential, role, invocation, and result mount identities.

nodes.name: validateResumeRequest
nodes.summary: Validates run and immutable image identity for worker resumption.

nodes.name: validateCommandRequest
nodes.summary: Validates command identity, shell content, role, policy, and explicit environment entries.

nodes.name: validateCacheMount
nodes.summary: Validates a named cache mount and ensures its host directory is safe and available.

nodes.name: validateEnvironmentEntryWithProtocol
nodes.summary: Validates environment names and values while rejecting forbidden, reserved, and interactive protocol variables.

nodes.name: validateImageName
nodes.summary: Rejects unsafe image references and enforces the adapter's image naming rules.

nodes.name: validateMountContract
nodes.summary: Checks requested mount destinations, uniqueness, and containment before Docker startup.

nodes.name: prepareWorkerMounts
nodes.summary: Constructs and sorts the complete Docker mount list for worktree, Git metadata, caches, roles, and invocation data.

nodes.name: prepareWorkerMount
nodes.summary: Walks a worker mount source and applies host-group ownership and permissions to regular files.

nodes.name: hostGroupID
nodes.summary: Extracts and validates the host group ID needed for worker mount permissions.

nodes.name: workerMountPermissions
nodes.summary: Computes restrictive worker mount modes while preserving required read or write behavior.

nodes.name: validateDirectory
nodes.summary: Validates that a path is absolute, free of unsafe separators, and an existing directory.

nodes.name: ensureCacheDirectory
nodes.summary: Validates or creates a safe cache directory and rejects non-directory paths.

nodes.name: validName
nodes.summary: Checks whether an identifier contains only the permitted worker-safe name characters.

nodes.name: validEnvironmentName
nodes.summary: Validates environment variable naming and excludes reserved protocol names.

nodes.name: validDigest
nodes.summary: Checks that an image digest uses the accepted sha256 prefix and hexadecimal payload.

nodes.name: baselineEnvironment
nodes.summary: Builds the minimal deterministic environment supplied to every worker command.

nodes.name: explicitEnvironment
nodes.summary: Sorts and serializes explicit invocation environment variables deterministically.

nodes.name: validateInteractiveRequest
nodes.summary: Validates interactive run, command, role, and environment inputs before host attachment.

nodes.name: isDockerRuntimeFailure
nodes.summary: Classifies command errors whose messages indicate a Docker runtime failure.
